channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Guatemalan Former Anti-Corruption Prosecutor Killed in Capital
item.description: Former Guatemalan anti-corruption prosecutor Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa was shot dead in Guatemala City, reviving concern over the safety of the justice officials who take on powerful political and criminal interests in the country.

item.title: Who is Kavya Maran beyond IPL? Meet biz star at centre of buzz - Her role at Sun TV, Sunrisers franchise, Maran family
item.description: Kavya Maran is in the spotlight amid reports of a wedding with music composer Anirudh Ravichander. Beyond the buzz, she is an executive director at Sun TV Network and a key figure in the Sun Group’s media and international cricket businesses.

item.title: Cancer drug prices may fall up to 70% from November 9 — What to know
item.description: Under the new directive, pharmaceutical companies must publish revised price lists on their official websites and circulate them widely among retailers and hospitals.

item.title: USCIS premium processing rule under review: What H-1B and green card applicants need to know
item.description: A proposed change to USCIS premium processing has entered White House review, raising fresh questions for H-1B and green card applicants. Here's what we know so far.

item.title: Indiana family restores eroded farmland to help protect a rare salamander — Report
item.description: The farm, managed by Ben Shireman and his family, had suffered years of severe erosion under continuous row cropping by a previous owner. Deep gullies cut through fields, while depleted soils, low crop yields and high input costs made the operation increasingly difficult to sustain.

item.title: Tesla driver allegedly asleep with Full Self-Driving on? Video shows car crashing into police vehicle in California
item.description: The incident occurred on October 13, 2026, on eastbound I-80, west of Air Base Parkway, while CHP officers from Solano County were investigating a fatal crash, the department said in a social media post accompanying video of the incident.

item.title: Kolkata stampede: PM Modi announces compensation as Murmu, Amit Shah and Mamata Banerjee express grief over tragedy
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, President Droupadi Murmu, Home Minister Amit Shah and Mamata Banerjee expressed grief after the deadly stampede at Kolkata's Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal. Modi announced financial assistance for victims' families and the injured.

item.title: France Protests: Cars torched, shops looted as police arrest 272 demonstrators
item.description: Violence erupts in Paris and other cities during nationwide protests over rising living costs

item.title: Indian pilot Smit Machchhar recounts flydubai cockpit attack: ‘Smit, do something. You can’t die like this’
item.description: Machchhar said he was screaming his colleague's name and trying to operate the switch to open the door when he lost consciousness for the first time.

item.title: Why is Marco Rubio skipping Delhi for Mumbai and Reliance hub Jamnagar? What it signals about India-US ties under Trump
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s decision to hold talks in Mumbai and visit Reliance Industries’ Jamnagar refinery highlights the business, energy and trade focus of his India trip. The itinerary has sparked a diplomatic debate amid strained India-US ties under President Donald Trump.

item.title: 17 dead in Kolkata Durga puja stampede: PM Modi announces ex gratia, Amit Shah to visit hospital; check top updates here
item.description: At least 17 people have died, including one child, while 25 others were reported to be injured in a stampede-like situation in Kolkata's Durga Puja pandal at Chorbagan. CM Suvendu Adhikari has shared an update from a hospital.

item.title: Trump trip, 14-min briefing & bar exam admission: Inside Katie Zacharia’s 5 days as Press Secretary before being fired
item.description: Katie Zacharia’s five-day tenure as White House press secretary ended after President Donald Trump advised her to reconsider job. Her brief first press briefing, nervous delivery and questions about her legal credentials drew scrutiny. Trump claimed he had not fired her and wanted her to be happy.

item.title: Kolkata stampede Highlights: At least 17 dead in crush; PM announces ₹2L ex gratia; President expresses condolences
item.description: Kolkata Chorbagan stampede Highlights: A stampede-like situation broke out at Kolkata's Chorbagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal on 17 October amid heavy rain and overcrowding. At least 17 people lost their lives in the incident. Reports of fatalities remain subject to official confirmation.

item.title: Only big pandals mean fat money? Why small Durga Puja committees in West Bengal are struggling
item.description: West Bengal’s Durga Puja season delivered uneven business gains, with major puja organisers, malls and e-commerce platforms reporting strong activity while smaller committees and traditional retailers struggled.&nbsp;

item.title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke granted bail after arrest in Delhi; asked to sign peace bond
item.description: Dipke was produced before a special executive magistrate at the Mandir Marg police station, which granted him bail subject to certain conditions

item.title: FSSAI issues notices to Nestlé India, HUL over misleading products and non-compliances; What are the claims?
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has issued notices to Hindustan Unilever (HUL) and Nestlé India over alleged violations. The regular has flagged two of their products.

item.title: At least 17 dead in stampede-like situation at Kolkata's Chorbagan Durga Puja pandal; CM Suvendu Adhikari at hospital
item.description: Several people were injured after a section of Kolkata's Chorbagan Sarbojanin Durga Puja pandal collapsed amid heavy crowds on Saptami evening.

item.title: India-New Zealand FTA: Sheep meat gets zero duty, kiwi fruit at 15% as tariff cuts take effect October 20
item.description: India has notified its first set of customs duty concessions for imports from New Zealand under the bilateral free trade agreement, with preferential rates taking effect on October 20.&nbsp;

item.title: Bengaluru’s ‘fat dog election’: 64 canine contenders, two finalists and an internet-fuelled showdown
item.description: Bengaluru has joined the viral fat dog craze with Fat Dogs of BLR, a community-driven contest that has narrowed 64 canine contenders to two finalists. The quirky competition is turning online votes into a community event.

item.title: Why is Green Visakha demanding a halt to Google’s $15 billion AI data centre project in Vizag?
item.description: The demand comes amid growing attention to the environmental and resource requirements of large data centres, which need substantial electricity and water to operate

item.title: Radisson Blu Delhi under FSSAI scanner: Cockroaches, flies, fungal-affected vegetables among food safety lapses
item.description: According to the notice shared by FSSAI on social media, inspections revealed multiple deficiencies at the hotel, ranging from refrigeration and pest control issues to inadequate checks on food quality and cooking oil suitability.

item.title: Pakistan, Bangladesh among 10 worst hunger-hit countries: Which other nations are on the list?
item.description: Pakistan and Bangladesh are among the 10 worst hunger-hit countries globally, according to Action Against Hunger. Nigeria, DR Congo, Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan, Myanmar, South Sudan and Syria are also on the list. Acute hunger affects around 266 million people across 47 countries.

item.title: FDA crackdown: FIR against Reliance Consumer Products, Reliance Retail, Blinkit, Zomato Hyperpure officials; here's why
item.description: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has seized food products worth ₹48 lakh during a crackdown across Thane and Pune districts. Licenses of five establishments have been suspended.

item.title: FSSAI initiates prosecution against Surya Food & Agro for using cattle feed bran in Priyagold biscuits production
item.description: The regulator has also initiated prosecution proceedings against Dodla Dairy and UEIR Organic Foods over food safety violations involving substandard full cream milk and pesticide residues in yellow raisins, respectively

item.title: Dubai-bound Emirates flight delayed at Delhi airport after a bird strike | Watch video
item.description: An Emirates flight from Delhi to Dubai was delayed Friday after a bird strike affected its departure schedule.

item.title: Air India, Air India Express extend Saudi Arabia flight suspension until Oct 24 amid Houthi strikes: What airline said
item.description: Air India and Air India Express have suspended flights to Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam until October 24 amid security concerns in West Asia following Houthi revel strikes. IndiGo on Thursday also extended the suspension of its flights to Saudi Arabian destinations until October 24.

item.title: Delhi Traffic Update: CR Park, GK-2 traffic curbs from 4 pm Saturday to midnight till October 20; check alternatives
item.description: Delhi Traffic Police has warned of possible congestion on eight major roads in South Delhi amid Durga Puja celebrations in Chittaranjan Park and Greater Kailash-2. Restrictions will remain in place from 4 pm to midnight daily until October 20.&nbsp;

item.title: Iran says supertanker carrying 2 million barrels of crude ablaze after hitting naval mine in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran’s IRGC Navy said a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of crude oil caught fire after hitting a naval mine while crossing the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorised route. The incident comes amid rising attacks on shipping and Tehran’s tightening grip on the strategic waterway.

item.title: FSSAI notifies draft amendment to tighten infant nutrition rules: What are the changes being proposed?
item.description: FSSAI has proposed banning the addition of sucrose and fructose to infant nutrition products for babies up to six months old. The draft amendment is open for public feedback for 60 days before the regulator considers finalising it.

item.title: FSSAI proposes ban on added sugar in baby food for infants aged up to six months
item.description: FSSAI’s draft amendment seeks to prohibit sucrose and fructose in infant nutrition products intended for babies aged up to six months, tightening standards amid concerns over early sugar exposure and childhood obesity.

item.title: Shankar Mahadevan’s new Delhi restaurant Malgudi: Location, menu and what diners can expect
item.description: Singer-composer Shankar Mahadevan has opened Malgudi’s first Delhi outlet in Rajouri Garden. The vegetarian restaurant serves traditional South Indian dishes alongside fusion options, regional specialities and inventive coffee.&nbsp;

item.title: SC says internet access is a fundamental right, rejects blanket ban for children: ‘Safety and freedom are not at odds’
item.description: The Supreme Court ruled that children, like all individuals, have a fundamental right to access and use the internet.

item.title: Trump waives some Russia oil sanctions, easing pressure on India
item.description: The move offers relief to major Russian oil buyers as India and the US push to finalize a trade deal, with crude prices above $100 a barrel adding to pressure on New Delhi’s import bill and inflation.

item.title: Who is Natasha Narwal? 2020 Delhi riots case accused to travel to the UK for academic purposes
item.description: The Delhi High Court has allowed activist Natasha Narwal, who is out on bail in the 2020 Delhi riots conspiracy case, to visit the UK for academic work. A founding member of Pinjra Tod, she must return to India, refrain from seeking asylum and surrender her passport within 48 hours of returning.

item.title: How California ultra-rich prepare to fight against proposed ‘world’s first billionaire tax’
item.description: Tech billionaires have reportedly raised more than $340 million to defeat 'Proposition 40', a one-time 5 percent wealth tax that will fund healthcare and education.
